events.title: F2P NEWS #1: A thank-you to our demo pilots: special achievements at launch!

events.title: Dev Update#1: A Boss Is Coming to Fox Two Protocol
events.summary: Hey, pilots!Something big is coming to the skies of Fox Two Protocol. We're working on the game's first boss, a massive heavy bomber built to be hunted by an entire squadron of fighters.It's not a flying target that just soaks up missiles. The boss carries its own defenses: turrets along its spine, on its wings and under its nose will keep you on your toes from every angle of attack.And it doesn't fly alone. events.title: Mini Update #9: A New Look for the Skies
events.summary: Hey, pilots!The skies of Fox Two Protocol have a new look! This update introduces a new volumetric cloud system with fuller shapes and richer lighting, from bright daytime skies to warm sunsets. Fly beneath the cloud layer, climb through the haze, and break out into the sunlight. Familiar missions feel a little different when the sky around you has more depth. Take it for a flight and let me know what you think. I’d love to see your screenshots!See you in the skies! ✈️

events.title: MiniUpdate #8: In-Game Guidance & Gameplay Settings
events.summary: Hey, pilots!This small update adds a little guidance when you need it, along with new settings and a few visual improvements.Added unobtrusive tutorial tips for missiles, flares, Swarm, and Hunter Grid. You can turn them off if you prefer to learn on your own or already know your way around.Added a Gameplay tab with settings for tutorial tips and the step-by-step briefing.Renamed the water reflection setting to “High-resolution water reflections” to make its purpose clearer.Reworked the upgrade

events.title: MiniUpdate #7: Ghost Racing Has Arrived!
events.summary: Hey, pilots!This update brings ghost racing to Fox Two Protocol! Fly through a series of checkpoints and compete against other players’ recorded runs. Follow their ghost through the course, find a better line, and try to beat their time.Speed matters, but so does precision. A tighter turn or a cleaner approach to the next checkpoint could make the difference between chasing a ghost and pulling ahead.One course is available for now, and I’m planning to add more in the full release.Give it a try a

events.title: MiniUpdate #6: Refined Mission Ratings
events.summary: Hey, pilots!This hotfix refines how mission ratings are calculated, so the grade you earn better reflects how well you flew. Completion time, combat efficiency, and survival now contribute to a more balanced overall result. Strong performances are rewarded more consistently, and small mistakes have a more proportionate impact on your final grade.The higher ranks, all the way up to SSS, should now feel like meaningful goals to work toward. Fly fast, make your shots count, and see how far you can

events.title: MiniUpdate #5 HUD Update
events.summary: The combat HUD has had a fresh pass, with a more cohesive military-instrument look and clearer information at a glance.The flight instruments, radar, and aircraft status panel now feel more like parts of the same cockpit. Your loadout is easier to read, unavailable weapon slots no longer clutter the display, and the central GUN and DEF readouts stay a consistent size when you adjust the rest of the HUD.Take it for a flight and let me know how it feels!

events.title: MiniUpdate #4 Global Leaderboards Are Here!
events.summary: Your best flights now have a place on the global leaderboards! Compare your scores with other pilots, browse the top 50, and find your own position even if you’re still working your way up. Each record also shows whether the pilot mostly used a mouse and keyboard or a gamepad.Your local flight history is still there — switch between Local and Global on the Score Board screen.The demo has its own separate leaderboards for all three missions. The full game includes mission leaderboards and Endless

events.title: Hotfix #3 — A New Feel for Gamepad Flight
events.summary: The gamepad camera now rolls with your aircraft, giving flight a more immersive, sim-like feel, especially through rolls and inverted maneuvers.Mouse and keyboard flight remains unchanged. I recommend giving both a try and choosing whichever feels best to you!

events.title: Hotfix #2 (Enemy)
events.summary: Hotfix: Enemy BehaviorUpdated enemy behavior and encounter pacing in the early missions for more engaging dogfights, less time searching for targets, and a smoother difficulty curve.

events.title: HotFix #1 (Loading/Performance + QoL)
events.summary: Hotfix & Quality of Life Update #1Improved loading, with some mission preparation now handled during startup.Fixed loading stalls when the game is minimized or running in the background.Fixed an issue where the hangar could fail to appear after returning from a mission.Improved transitions between city detail levels.Added an enemy-finding assist: after 40 seconds without contact, an orange marker points toward the nearest enemy and shows the distance.Updated enemy placement in the first mission.

events.title: The Fox Two Protocol demo is out now!
events.summary: The Fox Two Protocol demo is out now!Hey everyone!You can now download the free demo of Fox Two Protocol here on Steam. I’m really happy to finally share it with you and let you take it for a flight.The game is still in active development, so this demo is a look at where it stands today, not the finished game. There’s more work ahead, and I’d love to hear what you think after playing. Feedback and bug reports are welcome here in the community.Thank you for giving it a try. It means a lot to me.H
